<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the low-field signals typical for methyl carbons appear at 24.56 ppm, 19.40 ppm, 16.60 ppm, and also at 57.20 ppm (a methoxy‑type methyl). These four distinct carbon signals correspond to four CH₃ groups in the molecule.</thought>
<final_answer>4</final_answer>
